Missile Threat Reportedly Caused Trump's Plane Change

A report claims an Iranian shoulder-fired missile launcher prompted a change in Donald Trump's aircraft during a visit. The incident reportedly led to a "ruse" involving his plane. The specific details of the threat and the nature of the "ruse" were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
